'''Varos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed at the [[Jagged Plains]] Imperial Garrison in the [[Clabburn Tundra]] region on planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He asked a Sith individual to take care of his old master [[Ranor]].
